stones.label: Stepped Pyramid Roofs
stones.causal_role: Outward monumental shell promising a royal palace or throne hall, yet equally sheltering a leprosy ward or odalisques' steam-baths.

stones.label: Pine-Cone Pagodas, Garrets & Haymows
stones.causal_role: Multi-eaved temple spire rising beside garrets and haymows; expected to house high priests' sanctuaries, yet hosting iron anvils, cauldrons, or merchant scales.

stones.label: Groin-Vaulted Covered Markets
stones.causal_role: Arcaded stone bazaar bays promising commercial order, yet continuously occupied by sleeping mats, oracle tripods, or royal scepters.

stones.label: Scrawl of Canals & Gardens
stones.causal_role: Sinuous stone-embanked waterways and arched bridges threading gardens without ever establishing a lasting boundary between wards.

stones.label: Rubbish Heaps & Amphora Middens
stones.causal_role: Stratified mounds of shards, slag, and timber expected to mark an outcast slum, yet serving as throne dais, gold-assay counter, or augury locus.

stones.label: Nine Simultaneous Permuting Acts
stones.causal_role: Sleeping, tool-forging, cooking, gold-counting, reigning, trading, consulting oracles, leprosarium tending, and odalisque bathing—all nine alive at every moment and permuting freely across every shell.

stones.label: Dissolving Boundary Lines (Sacred/Profane, Royal/Artisan)
stones.causal_role: Every zoning-chalk boundary drawn by the stranger to separate functions provokes immediate cross-bleeding acts that fracture and dissolve the line to zero integrity.

stones.label: No Line Between Inside & Outside (Rumble of Wheels / Howl of Wolves)
stones.causal_role: Attempting to cross an outer city boundary between the rumble of wheels and the howl of wolves folds seamlessly back into another permutation of Zoe.

calvino_source.inner_arch: Indivisible existence: outward architectural form fails to declare inward function because every point of Zoe is capable of every human act at every moment, dissolving every boundary between sacred and profane, royal and outcast, inside and outside.

anti_trude_vector.medium: Toroidal architectural cutaway continuum, zoning-chalk boundary dissolution solver, 9-act simultaneous derangement & migration stage, polyphonic procedural WebAudio, plus Royal Plate Guild copperplate cartography (map.png / map.svg) and architectural plate (image.png).
anti_trude_vector.typography: Self-contained engraved humanistic serif ('Iowan Old Style', 'Palatino', 'Book Antiqua', Georgia, serif) paired with tabular technical monospace ('SF Mono', 'Menlo', monospace); zero external font URLs.

zoe-facade-architect.epistemic_partition: Models the 5 deceptive outward architectural shells (pyramid roofs, pine-cone pagodas, covered markets, canals, rubbish heaps), cutaway geometry, toroidal inside/outside perimeter fold, and interactive zoning-chalk lines that fracture and dissolve under cross-bleeding acts.

zoe-indivisible-life.epistemic_partition: Models all 9 simultaneous Calvino acts (sleeping, tool-forging, cooking, gold-counting, reigning, trading, consulting oracles, leprosarium tending, odalisque bathing), dynamic cross-shell derangement/migration streams, and polyphonic procedural WebAudio.

zoe-weaver.epistemic_partition: Weaves deceptive_forms.js and permutation_acts.js inline into a 100% standalone index.html with bespoke <zoe-continuum>, <form-illusion-grid>, <act-permutation-stage>, <boundary-dissolver>, and <zoe-plate-drawer> [P] elements, J_dom < 0.35, responsive 1280x800 & 390x844 layouts, keyboard & reduced-motion support.

zoe-critic.epistemic_partition: Blindfolded verifier auditing HG-1..HG-4, Playwright causal/viewport/console behavior, verify_trude.py standalone & J_dom < 0.35 checks, and Royal Plate Guild map.png/map.svg/image.png integrity.

hard_gates.HG-1: 100% standalone index.html: zero http:// or https:// URLs, zero ../ cross-city imports, bespoke custom elements (<zoe-continuum>, <form-illusion-grid>, <act-permutation-stage>, <boundary-dissolver>, <zoe-plate-drawer>) and 100% .zoe-* CSS classes achieving J_dom < 0.35.
hard_gates.HG-2: Causal indivisibility & boundary dissolution: all 5 deceptive shells (pyramid_roof, pagoda, covered_market, canal, rubbish_heap) and all 9 simultaneous acts permute dynamically so every shell hosts unexpected acts; drawing any zoning-chalk boundary (pointer drag or preset) provokes cross-bleeding acts that dissolve chalk integrity from 1.0 to 0.0; crossing/triggering the perimeter folds Zoe seamlessly back into Zoe.
hard_gates.HG-3: Polyphonic WebAudio, inspectable <zoe-plate-drawer> [P] wired to local map.png (map.svg fallback) and image.png, full keyboard controls ([1..4] chalk presets, [X]/[Space] permute, [W] perimeter fold, [M] mute, [R] reset, [P] plates, [Escape] close), and prefers-reduced-motion compliance.
hard_gates.HG-4: Zero console/page errors and zero viewport overflow at both 1280x800 desktop and 390x844 mobile, plus verified non-blank museum-grade map.png (1600x1200), map.svg, and image.png (1600x1000) on disk.
